topics.name: Vector Databases
topics.description: Databases optimized for storing and retrieving vector embeddings.

sub_topics.name: Vector Search
sub_topics.description: Techniques for searching through vector databases.

sub_topics.name: Similarity Search
sub_topics.description: Finding similar vectors based on distance metrics.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning and data structures.
common_misconceptions: Vector databases are the same as traditional databases
Only numerical data can be stored in vector databases

topics.name: Embeddings
topics.description: Representations of data in vector space for machine learning tasks.

sub_topics.name: Embedding Vectors
sub_topics.description: Vectors that represent data points in a continuous vector space.

sub_topics.name: Similar Vectors
sub_topics.description: Vectors that are close to each other in the embedding space.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra and machine learning concepts.
common_misconceptions: Embeddings are only for text data

topics.name: Retrieval Strategies
topics.description: Methods for retrieving relevant information from databases.

sub_topics.name: RAG Retrieval
sub_topics.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation techniques for information retrieval.

sub_topics.name: Relevance Retrieval
sub_topics.description: Techniques to ensure retrieved information is relevant to the query.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of databases and querying languages.
common_misconceptions: All retrieval methods are the same
Retrieval is only about keyword matching

topics.name: Neural Networks
topics.description: Computational models inspired by the human brain for processing data.

sub_topics.name: Encoder Models
sub_topics.description: Models that transform input data into a different representation.

sub_topics.name: Activation Functions
sub_topics.description: Functions that determine the output of a neural network node.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra and calculus, familiarity with programming concepts.
common_misconceptions: Neural networks can learn without data
More layers always mean better performance

topics.name: Training Techniques
topics.description: Methods used to train machine learning models.

sub_topics.name: Backpropagation
sub_topics.description: Algorithm for training neural networks by minimizing error.

sub_topics.name: Loss Functions
sub_topics.description: Functions that measure the difference between predicted and actual outcomes.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning and statistics.
common_misconceptions: All models require the same amount of data
More complex models always perform better

topics.name: Prompt Engineering
topics.description: Techniques for designing effective prompts for models.

sub_topics.name: Creating Prompts
sub_topics.description: Methods for generating prompts to elicit desired responses.

sub_topics.name: Effective Prompts
sub_topics.description: Characteristics of prompts that yield high-quality outputs.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of natural language processing and machine learning concepts.
common_misconceptions: Prompts only need to be clear

topics.name: Similarity Scores
topics.description: Metrics used to quantify the similarity between data points.

sub_topics.name: Calculating Similarity
sub_topics.description: Methods for computing similarity scores between vectors.

sub_topics.name: Reference Similarity
sub_topics.description: Comparing vectors against a reference point for similarity.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and linear algebra.
common_misconceptions: Higher scores always indicate better similarity.

topics.name: Search Techniques
topics.description: Methods for efficiently searching through data.

sub_topics.name: Combining Semantic Search
sub_topics.description: Integrating semantic understanding into search processes.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of data structures and algorithms.
common_misconceptions: Binary search can be used on unsorted data.
All search techniques have the same efficiency.

topics.name: Document Collections
topics.description: Groups of documents used for training and retrieval tasks.

sub_topics.name: Collection Documents
sub_topics.description: Sets of documents used for various machine learning applications.

sub_topics.name: Metadata Information
sub_topics.description: Data that provides context about the documents.

summary.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of text processing and machine learning principles.
common_misconceptions: All documents in a collection are of the same type.
Document collections are only used for training.
